content:
Updates a domain associated with the specified account UUID.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
Example: 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6
The UUID of the customer account you want to update a domain for.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
required
string
The domain name you want to update.
string
Enum: "ACTIVE"
"DISABLED"
The status you want to set for the domain.
string
Enum: "PRIMARY"
"SECONDARY"
The type you want to set for the domain.
